SEARCH
Package com.helix.core.bytecode

Class BytecodeCompiler

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.bytecode.BytecodeCompiler
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes
public class BytecodeCompiler extends Object implements org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes
ASM Bytecode Compiler capable of standard zero-overhead compilation and dynamic debug instrumentation injecting probe hooks before condition branch jumps.
